gaps: P0: no candidates. P2: only street plans (#9–14). P1 alternative not used: Braun and Hogenberg 1618 (#1), a colored plan with buildings drawn.
notes: #7 (Jan van Londerseel bird’s-eye view) is a strong view but dated only 1608–65; skipped for the date doubt. P3 alternative: Jan ten Compe’s 1750 distant view (#17, MAS Antwerp), skyline too small to recognize. P5 alternative: firmly dated 1934 aerial of the Bezuidenhout district (#29), housing only. #35, #38–40 are recent photos of 19th–20th-century paintings, not modern views.
